chapter.introduction: Jotham reigns well and prospers, ver. 1-6. The conclusion of his reign, ver. 7-9.

content.text: He did - He did according to all that his father Uzziah did; except in his miscarriages. We must not imitate those we have the greatest esteem for, any farther than we do well; but their failings must be warnings to us, to walk more circumspectly.
Built - Repaired it: for it was built before, chap.11:5.
